title: ever SIMONE|Short Sleeves Leaf Sequin A-Line Midi Formal Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Step into elegance with our Short Sleeves Leaf Sequin A-Line Midi Formal Wedding Guest Dress. This beautiful dress features intricate leaf sequin detailing, adding a touch of glamour to the classic A-line silhouette. The short sleeves and midi length offer a perfect blend of style and comfort, making it ideal for wedding celebrations. Designed to flatter your figure, this dress ensures you look and feel stunning on any special occasion.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi Length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
